edits.current: Marks the employee's exit. Pairs with the termination date in campo 81 and reduces the contributory days in campos 36 to 39.
edits.proposed: Marks the employee's exit from the systems settled in the return. AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.8 campo 16 admits X (the contributor withdraws the member from ALL the systems being settled), P (withdrawal from the General Pension System only) and R, C and T, which are restricted to independent contributor types (16, 57, 59; 3, 4, 33, 34, 35, 53) and never apply to a dependent employee: for a dependent employee the value is X in the period in which the termination date falls, blank otherwise. Pairs with the termination date in campo 81 (T2R2-081), which the engine always populates although the annex makes it optional when RET is reported, and reduces the contributory days in campos 36 to 39: fewer than 30 days may be reported only where an ING or RET event exists (§2.1.2.3.11 to 2.1.2.3.13), the days run from the first day of the period to the termination date inclusive, and a termination on the last calendar day of the month reports 30 days (AT2 day-count example table). Where the employee is in an absence event (SLN, IGE, LMA, VAC-LR, IRL) in the same period, the RET line is a separate record with its own IBC (§2.1.2.2). Source: the termination date of the contract (Contract.End_Date), the same date as the final settlement's 'Fecha de Retiro' and electronic payroll FechaRetiro (NIE003). A termination processed after the return of its period was paid is reported for THAT period through a correction return (T2R1-008 = N), not in the period in which the final settlement is paid.

edits.basis: AT2 (Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Tecnico 2) §2.1.2.3.8 campo 16; §2.1.2.3.11-2.1.2.3.13 campos 36-38 ('Es permitido reportar menos de 30 dias cuando exista una novedad de ingreso o retiro'); §2.1.2.2 (retiro during an absence event: separate line); Registro tipo 2 campo 81 ('Es un campo opcional cuando se reporte la novedad de retiro ... siempre y cuando la novedad se presente en el periodo que se este liquidando'); AT2 day-count example table (Retiro 29-02 / 30-03 / 31-03 = 30 days); AT2 §2.1.2.1 note on forma de presentacion U (retiro reported 'a traves del tipo de planilla N'). Quoted from the AT2 v27 text (25-03-2025); the spec cites v30 (24-07-2026) - Wallisson to confirm the wording is unchanged before applying.

edits.current: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, P, R, X or C. Where marked, 'Termination date' (T2R2-081) becomes mandatory.
edits.proposed: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, P, R, X or C. Where marked, the engine populates 'Termination date' (T2R2-081) with the termination date (AT2 v30 campo 81 makes the date optional when RET is reported; the engine's own interlock requires it).
